reading.title: Fiscal Impact Statement for CR-115-2025: A Resolution concerning Payments in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) Agreement for the New Carrollton Affordable Phase 4 Project

candidates.quote: The Resolution proposes to approve the terms and conditions of a Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) agreement between Prince George’s County and Urban Atlantic Development for a 102- unit multi-family development available at 70% of Area Median Income.

The Resolution proposes to approve the terms and conditions of a Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) agreement between Prince George’s County and Urban Atlantic Development for a 102- unit multi-family development available at 70% of Area Median Income.
The PILOT would be in effect for 40 years.

Assuming a first -year payment of $66,300 in FY 2027 instead of a real property tax payment of $172,747, the County loses -$106,447 in general fund revenue, growing to a loss of - $118,407 by FY 2030.
Over the 40- year term of the PILOT the County is estimated to lose -$4.6 million on a net present value basis.
The first-year PILOT payment is specified at $66,300 growing by 2% annually over the 40-year term.
The revenue loss should be weighed against the benefit of adding 102 affordable housing units that may not have been constructed in the absence of the PILOT agreement.
